name: English
title: Aether Lemric — projects, issues and teamwork
description: Track issues, plan sprints and work with boards. Aether Lemric brings workflows, permissions and time records together. Install on your own servers.
heroTitle: A shared plan. A clear next step.
heroDescription: Issues, boards and sprints in one place. See what needs doing, who owns it and how work moves towards completion. Install Aether Lemric on your own servers.
stageNote: A new application from Lemric, built with software development experience.
featuresTitle: Organised issues. Clear rules for your team.
issuesDescription: Issues with priorities, assignees and a change history. Lists, backlogs and boards help your team plan work and follow its progress.
workflowDescription: Define states, transitions and requirements for your project. Workflow rules determine which steps are available and what is needed to complete an issue.
timeTitle: Time linked to the work done.
timeDescription: Log time manually or with a timer. Submit periods for approval and keep a correction history that gives time records context.
previewTitle: See your work from different perspectives.
previewDescription: A simplified presentation with sample data. Tabs illustrate product areas; this is not a session in the running application.
flowDescription: A transition changes an issue's state. Conditions determine when that transition can take place.
flowRuleText: Closing the issue requires approval. Without it, the issue remains in progress.
hostingDescription: The Server edition lets you maintain the application and its data. You choose where it runs and how access is managed.
selfDescription: Install Aether in your environment. Your organisation manages the server, data, backups and updates.
cloudDescription: The service edition is a separate deployment model. Confirm service availability and terms before choosing it.
launchTitle: Evaluate Aether with your own workflow.
launchDescription: Explore issues, boards, workflows and time records. See how access and processes fit your team’s needs.
launchTiming: Confirm distribution terms and availability for the specific release.
componentsDescription: Divide a project into areas and assign issues to them. Find work related to a particular part of the product.
releasesDescription: Link issues to versions. Check the scope of a release and which tasks still need work.
developmentDescription: An example integration direction: code changes linked to an issue. Data availability depends on the integration and application version.
dashboardDescription: Issue statuses, priorities and project progress in one view. A starting point for the team's daily review of its work.
boardsDescription: Organise the backlog, plan sprints and follow the flow of issues. Adapt columns, swimlanes and filters to your team’s work.
ganttDescription: A sample schedule view with tasks on a timeline. This illustrates a planning direction; check Gantt availability in the chosen release.
